# audiogen

- purpose: Pure-Rust game audio asset pipeline (procedural SFX, MP3/WAV/FLAC encoding, async MiniMax music/voice jobs over SSH/Redis)
- version: 0.1.0
- binary: audiogen (plus helper binary dry_run)
- contract: `rlit_cli` (global `--json` envelope, `audiogen __schema`, exit codes 0-5)
- build: cd audiogen && cargo build --release
- input: JSON job manifest (`--jobs jobs/<game>.json`)
- output: encoded audio files in `output_dir` (mp3/wav/flac) + pending state `.pending.json`

## Commands

- `audiogen --jobs <file> status` — list jobs and completion state
- `audiogen --jobs <file> sfx [--only a,b]` — synthesize procedural SFX offline
- `audiogen --jobs <file> submit [--only a,b]` — enqueue AI music/voice jobs via SSH (`AUDIOGEN_VPS`, `AUDIOGEN_SSH_KEY`)
- `audiogen --jobs <file> collect [--max-wait 600]` — wait and decode queued AI results
- `audiogen --jobs <file> install` — copy `output_dir` assets to `install_dir`
- `cargo run --bin dry_run -- <file>` — validate manifest and print request envelopes

## Codecs & Dependencies

- encode: mp3 (`shine-rs`), wav (native), flac (`flacenc`)
- decode: mp3/flac/ogg/aac (`symphonia`), wav (native)
- transport: `russh` + `russh-keys` (pure Rust SSH, no system ssh binary required)
